basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Columbus, Ohio, with a penchant for building custom PCs and a passion for fly fishing. By day, I work as a systems analyst for a mid-sized tech company, and by night, I indulge in my hobbies, which also include experimenting with homemade kombucha. I'm married, with no kids, and my wife and I enjoy exploring the local art scene. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends, often diving deep into tech threads or sharing insights on fly fishing techniques.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over 15 years of experience in IT, I've honed my expertise through a combination of formal education and self-directed learning. I frequently participate in tech forums and have built several PCs over the years, keeping abreast of the latest hardware trends.
